newsitem.title: USA: NYSE chairman blasts California Proposition 211.
newsitem.headline: NYSE chairman blasts California Proposition 211.

text.p: New York Stock Exchange Chairman Richard Grasso blasted California's proposition 211, calling the inititive "an absolute nuclear device aimed at the heart of good corporate governance and the entire corporate community."

Proposition 211, on the November ballot, would make corporate executives and directors personally liable for losses and for civil damages in shareholder lawsuits over statements, or omission of statements, regarding material facts related to companies.
Grasso, speaking at the Financial Executives Institute annual meeting, said independent directors and management would "think twice" whether to serve.
He said the measure, promoted as a way to protect investors from securities fraud, is "not a consumer bill of rights, simply a full employment act for frivolous lawsuit proponents."
